Came here for the first time to get a trouser made for an elderly family  member .
Patrick at the store was very helpful. …

Had a fantastic experience at The Raymond Shop, Koramangala—highly recommended!

I was on the lookout for a great suit for my engagement and initially visited …

Worst experience for alteration. We were asked to come twice but they refused to alter the suits even if they were all Raymond Suits. We wasted our time coming here twice, even though they assured us on phone that they do take alterations …
